heroHeadline: We build mobile experiences worth playing.
heroBody: ChicMouse Studio is a premium independent studio crafting high-quality mobile games with obsessive attention to detail.
featuredCardP1: Merge matching celestial objects to evolve them into something greater — planets become star systems, star systems become galaxies.
featuredCardP2: A satisfying one-hand puzzle with no timers and no pressure. Play for five minutes or settle in for a long cosmic journey.
studioTextLeft: We believe in quality over quantity, focusing on crafting unique and polished experiences that leave a lasting impression on every player who picks them up.
studioTextRight: Our small, dedicated team is passionate about pushing the boundaries of mobile gaming, building mechanics that respect your intelligence and reward genuine skill.
pillar1Body: We prioritize meaningful engagement over empty metrics, designing mechanics that respect your intelligence and time.
pillar2Body: Minimalist aesthetics meeting maximalist functionality. Our interfaces are built to disappear, leaving only the experience.
pillar3Body: Custom-built engines and proprietary tools allow us to push visual boundaries that off-the-shelf solutions simply cannot reach.

stellarFusionDescP1: Stellar Fusion is a satisfying cosmic puzzle game built around a simple idea: combine matching celestial objects to evolve them into something greater. Planets become star systems, star systems become galaxies.
stellarFusionDescP2: With an intuitive one-hand design and a tranquil atmosphere, Stellar Fusion is built to be played anywhere — whether for a quick session or a long cosmic journey. No timers, no pressure.
stellarFusionFeature1Body: Drag and drop matching objects to combine them into new celestial bodies. Each merge reveals a new tier of cosmic wonder waiting to be discovered.
stellarFusionFeature2Body: Dozens of unique celestial bodies to unlock. Every session builds toward something bigger, with meaningful milestones and rewards along the way.
stellarFusionFeature3Body: No timers, no intrusive ads. Stellar Fusion is designed to be a focused, relaxing experience — play entirely at your own pace.
cookieBannerDescription: We use Google Fonts (external CDN) to display text on this site. When you submit the contact form your name and email are sent to our inbox — they are not stored on your device.
